description: This Java source file defines the NamespaceBlockedException class, a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a namespace is blocked due to an ongoing operation. It includes methods for creating, serializing, and deserializing the exception, as well as a builder for customization.

classes.name: NamespaceBlockedException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an exception when a namespace is blocked.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class providing a mutable builder with a fluent API for constructing NamespaceBlockedException instances.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for NamespaceBlockedException with a default message, given the namespace.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a NamespaceBlockedException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current exception's data.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated headers.
